answer: Alias farms fail when each name must occupy a circuit nobody can photocopy. The applicant rents one night-safe vault cubby, carries a sealed barograph from an assigned summit lookout, and punches a silt coupon at a leased delta gauge in a published 11-minute slot. Clerks post C=ripemd160(addr||cubby||lookout_id||coupon_root||slot). Fee is 0.47 POA; 21 POA bonds eleven epochs. Auditors overlay the tape on the lookout's public pressure feed and match the coupon assay to that gauge bed. A doubled cubby, reused coupon, or short barograph seizes the bond and parks both keys for fourteen epochs.
